caption: The drawing depicts a square-shaped pattern resembling a needlepoint or cross-stitch design, centered on a cream-colored background. The main area of the design is filled with a red grid, providing a backdrop for the other shapes. Over the red background, there are clusters of white shapes, which appear in groups and are bordered by lines of darker brown and tan. Green blocks form a diagonal pattern through the white clusters, with varying shades of green filling the pattern to suggest leaves. The composition also includes brown and yellow shapes scattered among the green and white shapes, and there is a vertical border on the right side featuring a twisted rope or cord pattern in alternating diagonal stripes of gray and cream. The entire pattern is presented within a rectangular border with clear grid lines that segment the colored shapes into small, square-like modules.
title: Afghan
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
